attributes.storage_instructions: On opening, transfer the contents of the pack along with the pouch into a clean airtight container. Replace the lid tightly after every use and store in a cool, dry place. Ensure enclosed scoop is thoroughly washed and dried before use. After opening, use the contents within 3 weeks or best before date, whichever is earlier. Contraindication: Not for children with galactosemia or lactose intoleran
